description: This file sets up and runs a conversational pipeline using various AI services, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and transport mechanisms, with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

classes.name: TavusTransport
classes.description: Transport class for Tavus API handling input/output and events.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline task.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context messages for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates context and user parameters for LLM interactions.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns with smart turn strategies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and runs the conversation pipeline.

methods.name: on_client_connected
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a client connects, initiates conversation.

methods.name: on_client_disconnected
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a client disconnects, cancels ongoing tasks.
